newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil decree adds ports to sell-off list.
newsitem.headline: Brazil decree adds ports to sell-off list.

text.p: The Brazilian government Friday published a decree adding eight ports and docks to its privatization list.

The decree, published in the government's Official Journal, lists for sale Companhia Docas do Estado de Sao Paulo (CODESP), CDRJ of Rio de Janeiro, CODEPA of Bahia, CDC of Ceara, CDP of Para, CODOMAR of Maranhao, CODERN of Rio Grande do Norte and CODESA of Espirito Santo.
Planning Minister Antonio Kandir announced in June, shortly after taking office, that the government planned to extend its privatization programme to include 31 ports.

He said at the time that the government would auction concessions to operate the ports of Porto Velho, Laguna, Cabedelo and Itajai. The rest were to be offered to private investors under leasehold agreements.
